streamElements.howTo: Sign in at streamelements.com, open your account's Channels tab (streamelements.com/dashboard/account/channels), turn on Show secrets and copy the JWT token. It grants full access to your channel, so keep it private.

gauPoints.howTo: Sign in at gaupoints.com.br, open your browser's developer tools, and copy the value of the kp_session cookie. It lasts seven days; you are emailed before it runs out.

onboarding.title: Get started
onboarding.description: Three steps and PointLurker starts watching loyalty stores for you.

credential.title: Connect a provider
credential.body: Paste your StreamElements JWT token or your GauPoints session cookie. Settings shows where to find each.

store.title: Add a store
store.body: Pick the loyalty store you want to watch. It is checked for new and restocked items on every sync.

wishlist.title: Wishlist an item
wishlist.body: Open a store and wishlist what you want. You get an email when it is back in stock.

autoRedeem.title: Turn on auto-redeem
autoRedeem.body: With an item on your wishlist, auto-redeem can claim it the moment it is available. Items that ask for extra input, such as a Steam trade link, take it from the store's profile.

complete.title: You're all set
complete.body: PointLurker is watching your stores and emails you when a wishlisted item is in stock.
